evidence.t: Shushartie Lake, 7.4 ha, 20 m from the road.
About 12 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Shushartie River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 136 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

seasonRows.notes: District 1. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6. Date for 2026 to 2027, worked out from the federal wording and matched to the BC synopsis (page 21 Region 1, page 28 Region 2). It moves each year.

plan: Drive: from District of Port Hardy, about 36 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.80419, -127.80533, pull off on Georgie Lake Main FSR (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: none. The spot is at the road.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-13, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-08-24, closures 2026-10-16.
R1C-duck-drive-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 1-13: about 2,043 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.23 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
